title: AC1027 HEADER suffix retry after user unlock
scope: Retry the existing AC1027 Cover source with the installed ODA File Converter after the user reported unlocking the Mac; determine whether the invocation reaches document processing.

decision: The latest user-reported unlock did not change this direct CLI launch failure. Do not repeat the same invocation while its launch environment and method are unchanged. Continue independent local implementation; retry only if a functioning GUI or another changed invocation environment becomes available.
